name: rumindium-invoice
description: Sales-document generator for quotations, invoices, delivery orders and receipts.

scripts.dev: concurrently --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace @rumindium/api && npm run build --workspace @rumindium/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspace @rumindium/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @rumindium/web
